article.story: MILWAUKEE -- — Jake Hansen had 17 points in Milwaukee’s 99-48 victory against Ripon on Sunday. Hansen shot 5 of 10 from the field, including 5 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 3 from the line for the Panthers (1-2). Nate Malosa scored 15 points and added 11 rebounds and three steals. Chandler Jackson went 6 of 8 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with 15 points. Anton Kilde led the Redhawks in scoring, finishing with eight points. Up next Milwaukee visits Indiana State in its next matchup on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
